summary: Availability/booking reviewed and tested through the public URL. Final pytest: 11/17 pass; six deterministic defects confirmed on rerun. Public frontend compiles/loads, unauthenticated and patient availability guards pass, supplied doctor/patient logins pass, disposable doctor schedule save/reload and time-off create/delete pass, patient books Dr. Anaya Shah next Monday and sees Scheduled entry; booked slot disappears from API and UI. No product code changed.

critical.issue: Malformed ISO start/end returns HTTP 500. Backend log confirms uncaught ValueError in _parse_iso at availability/router.py:48,91.
Partial time-off overlap is not excluded: Monday 09:15-09:45 time-off still exposes 09:00-09:30. Predicate checks only slot start, not appointment interval.
India timezone mismatch: weekly 09:00 becomes 09:00 UTC / 14:30 IST. Schedule input has no timezone and chips render browser-local times.
Past Monday dates return available slots. Booking reuses the same engine with no future-time guard; past booking acceptance is a code-review finding, not separately executed.
A doctor can book themselves as the patient: HTTP 200 with patient_id==doctor_id. Endpoint uses get_current_user instead of patient-role enforcement.

minor.issue: Overlapping/duplicate weekly blocks accepted and return duplicate timestamps. Two identical blocks generate four slots instead of two; frontend uses timestamp as React key/test selector.

ui_bugs.issue: Initial rapid edit lost newly added block: block-1 existed while editing but disappeared before slot selection. Retest after 1-second load settling passed. Likely overlapping StrictMode load calls: first completion clears loadingSchedule while second can still replace blocks. Save also remains enabled during initial loading.
At 390px all role navigation links are hidden, with no mobile menu. Doctor Availability and patient Appointments are unreachable from navigation.

Browser console logs invalid <span> child inside <option> for slot-minute options. Stack shows preview visual-editor instrumentation injecting data-ve-dynamic spans into {m}m. No pageerror crash observed.

issues: Single 12-column schedule row compresses day/time/duration fields until values are truncated or unreadable; no page-wide horizontal overflow.
Native date and datetime-local browser pickers are used rather than shadcn calendar.
Time-off start/end have no visible From/To labels; datetime-local placeholders are not rendered, leaving two indistinguishable inputs.
Top-right success toast temporarily overlaps identity/logout controls; a forced logout click during the toast did not activate navigation.

action_items: Validate time-off datetimes and return 400/422 instead of 500.
Exclude any overlapping slot interval, not only starts; normalize India schedule timezone and reject past slots.
Enforce patient role for booking and deduplicate/reject overlapping weekly blocks.
Make schedule loading/editing concurrency-safe and disable Save until loading completes successfully.
Add mobile navigation, stack schedule controls on mobile, label time-off From/To, and prevent toasts covering logout.
Review code-only risks below, then rerun availability tests and browser flows.
critical_code_review_comments: Booking check-then-insert is not atomic and there is no unique active doctor/slot index. Six simultaneous requests produced one success/five 409 in this test, so duplicate concurrent booking was NOT reproduced; race risk remains by inspection.
DoctorAvailability.load silently maps API failures to empty schedule/time-off. Save is enabled while loading and after failed loading, risking replacing existing hours with an empty list.

Appointments slot requests lack stale-response cancellation/generation guards; changing doctor/date rapidly can display an old grid. API errors are silently shown as no available slots; appointments reload has no catch/error state. Not reproduced in this run.

Availability slots are UTC but time-off converts local input to UTC; the doctor schedule has no visible timezone. Normalize server instants while interpreting recurring hours in a defined clinic timezone.
Critical informational loading/empty/status texts lack individual data-testid attributes, although all exercised availability and booking controls have usable selectors.

success_rate.backend: 64.7% (11/17 final tests; 10/10 core API checks pass)
success_rate.frontend: Core booking and disposable schedule-save flows pass; rapid initial edit failed once and mobile navigation fails; no aggregate percentage assigned

test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Used supplied doctor@wyshcare.io and patient@wyshcare.io / TestPass123!; created uniquely named TEST_ disposable doctor/patient accounts for write tests.
seed_data_creation: No seed/reset scripts executed. Seeded doctor schedule never saved or changed: unsaved Add/edit/remove only. Schedule-save tested with disposable doctor. API fixture accounts, identities, schedules, time-off and appointments removed using only captured IDs. UI appointment apt_95d10f2dadd14a84 cancelled and deleted; UI doctor usr_6b02aa07fd6c4d13 and its schedule/identity deleted. Normal audit events retained.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL comes from frontend/.env. Environment clock was 2026-11-07, so next Monday used was 2026-11-09 (not a hardcoded February date). Run: set -a; source /app/frontend/.env; set +a; pytest /app/backend/tests/test_availability_booking.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/availability_results.xml. Six failures were identical on two runs; no flaky API tests. Initial UI block-loss failed once, passed with settle wait; treat race as unresolved. Avoid force-clicking nav logout while success toast covers it. Prior test_wyshcare_backend.py was not run: outdated fixed-date booking and missing cleanup make it unsafe/unrelated to this task. Playbook file preserves executed patient sequence; use external async harness to invoke run(page). App integrations are NOT MOCKED; no product code fixes were made.
rca of the issue: Time-off 500: unchecked string dates reach datetime.fromisoformat. Overlap bug: s<=slot_start<e ignores slot_end. Duplicate grid: candidates list is not deduplicated and schedule accepts overlap. Past dates: no now/future filtering. India time shift: datetime.combine uses timezone.utc for unzoned recurring hours. Doctor-as-patient: generic auth dependency. Mobile navigation: hidden md:flex with no mobile replacement. Initial UI lost edit likely from StrictMode two load calls independently setting loadingSchedule=false and replacing blocks.
